The default CSV delimiter is a comma. `library/csv.rst` documents `Dialect.delimiter` as "A one-character string used to separate fields. It defaults to `','`."

The in-memory text stream class is `io.StringIO`. `library/io.rst` says "In-memory text streams are also available as `StringIO` objects". `io.BytesIO` is the binary counterpart, per `whatsnew/3.0.rst`.

Sources: `library/csv.rst`, `library/io.rst`, `whatsnew/3.0.rst`
